name: AI answer visibility tracker
why: An agent that runs the same buyer questions through AI assistants each month and reports share of mentions, the loop behind the fortnightly AI citation check.

name: AI recommendation panel runner
why: Runs shopper questions across assistants and records who is named and which sources are cited, the sampling step of the visibility audit.

name: AI recommendation gap finder
why: Turns panel results into gaps marked fix, build or influence, matching the gap types in the ai-answer-visibility-audit skill.

name: AI citation source finder
why: Finds the sites AI tools keep citing for buyer questions and who to contact, the first step of earned source outreach.

name: Get your store named on the pages AI quotes
why: A full workflow from cited sources to a plan to appear on them, for online shops.

name: Brand facts accuracy fixer
why: Checks what AI says about a store against the truth and lists a fix for each wrong fact, a shop-focused version of the brand-facts-and-entity-audit skill.

name: Answer-first page rewriter
why: Rewrites guides and FAQ pages answer first and lists facts that still need a source, close to the citation-ready-page-rewrite skill.

name: AI-ready product page editor
why: Puts product facts, spec tables and FAQs into a form AI tools can read and quote.

name: Bot and AI agent access planner
why: Decides which bots and AI agents to allow, check or block around logins and checkout, alongside the ai-crawler-access-review skill.

name: AI traffic tracking set-up
why: Sets up an AI traffic channel, a post-purchase question and redirects, like the ai-referral-tracking-setup workflow.

name: Shopper question and fan-out mapper
why: Groups the questions shoppers ask AI and the follow-up searches behind them, a source for the buyer prompt set.

name: Journalist query answer writer
why: Writes expert answers to journalist requests, an honest way to earn the third-party coverage AI engines cite.

name: FAQ page writer from customer questions
why: Builds a page of real customer questions with direct answers, useful for quotable content when kept to genuine questions.

name: SEO and AI search agency vetter
why: Reviews agency proposals for red flags, a companion to the aeo-vendor-claim-check prompt.
